newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria's president meets politicians on elections.
newsitem.headline: Algeria's president meets politicians on elections.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual on Saturday met seven political personalities to discuss forthcoming parliamentary elections, Algerian state-run radio said.
The talks were preceded on Tuesday and Thursday by meetings between Zeroual and 28 party leaders to discuss preparations for the parliamentary elections planned for the first half of this year.

Political sources told Reuters by telephone that Zeroual, a former army general, was trying to reassure politicians that his government would ensure security to protect voters and candidates in the poll against Moslem rebel attacks.

Among the political figures who attended Saturday's talks was Abdelmajid Sidi Said, leader of Algeria's main union, along with officials from the retired army officers' association and the Algerian independence war fighters' organisation.
Algeria has been without parliament since 1992 when the authorities cancelled a general election in which radical Islamists had taken a commanding lead.
About 60,000 people have been killed since then in the Algerian conflict pitting government forces against Moslem guerrillas.
